description: This file provides utilities for video processing, specifically a lightweight MJPEG generator that overlays detection results on video frames. It includes a function that lazily initializes a cv2.VideoCapture object, performs frame-wise detection overlay, and streams frames suitable for Flask response. It is designed to work with external detector objects exposing a detect_plates method.

methods.name: _draw_detections(frame, detections)
methods.description: Overlays bounding boxes and labels onto a video frame based on detection data.

methods.name: Generator[bytes,None,None] mjpeg_generator(detector, cam_index: int = 0, width: int = 640, height: int = 480, target_fps: int = 10)
methods.description: Generates MJPEG frames with overlaid detection boxes for streaming, initializing video capture lazily and optionally simulating frames if OpenCV is unavailable.
